g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
MCPJam projects (read-only; authoring lives in
the app)
Conformance:
conformance Hosted conformance runs on saved servers: start,
poll, read failures
Observability:
trace-destinations|traces Stream an organization's traces to an OTLP/HTTP
endpoint (Coralogix, Honeycomb, Grafana, a
collector). Header values are write-only: no
command prints one.
Swarms and user testing:
goals|journeys List goals and inspect their runs (the Swarms
product) in your hosted MCPJam projects
personas The reusable synthetic characters Swarms goals
run as. A persona carries a name, a role and
behavioural notes; the task lives on each goal.
swarms Swarm containers group goals authored together
and hold their shared execution config. A goal
does not need one, but a project authored
through the app will have them.
studies|scenarios Publish project environments as studies, read
what testers did, and control who can reach them
Support:
feedback [options] Send feedback about MCPJam itself (a bug, a
missing capability, something confusing) to the
MCPJam team. Your text is sent to the MCPJam
team, outside your organization, and stored for
180 days. Requires a signed-in account.
Commands:
help [command] display help for command
[exit=0; signal=None; timeout=unrecorded]
